blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Eighteen teachers, school leaders and support staff were honored on Friday for doing their jobs with integrity. Education (DepEd) Secretary Sonny Angara told them that hard work and discipline matter most “when no one is watching.” “Ang sipag at disiplina ay hindi lamang mga salitang magandang ilagay sa isang programa o sa isang plaque. They are values we must live by, especially when the work is difficult, when the recognition is absent, and when no one is watching,” Angara said at the 14th Ambassador Cabangon Chua Gintong Parangal para sa Edukasyon awards. “Thank you for reminding us that […]...
